config.title: Berlin Bridge Days 2027 - FAQ
config.subtitle: Which 2027 Berlin public holidays fall on a working day, what each bridge day costs in leave, where the Berlin school holidays collide with them, and what the leave law actually says.

items.q: What are the Berlin bridge days in 2027?
items.a: **There is one classic bridge day and a handful of cheap weeks.** Ascension Day is Thursday 6 May 2027, so **Friday 7 May** is the single bridge day worth planning around: one leave day and you are off from Thursday to Sunday. Beyond that, the good windows are the Women's Day week (Tuesday 9 to Friday 12 March, four days for nine off), either Easter week (four days for ten off), and the Whitsun week (Tuesday 18 to Friday 21 May, four days for nine off).

items.q: Which Berlin public holidays fall on a weekend in 2027?
items.a: **Four of the ten.** Labour Day on 1 May 2027 is a Saturday, German Unity Day on 3 October is a Sunday, Christmas Day on 25 December is a Saturday and Boxing Day on 26 December is a Sunday. That leaves six on working days: New Year's Day (Friday 1 January), Women's Day (Monday 8 March), Good Friday (26 March), Easter Monday (29 March), Ascension Day (Thursday 6 May) and Whit Monday (17 May).

items.q: How many leave days do I need for the best 2027 plan?
items.a: **Thirteen leave days return thirty-two days off.** That is the Women's Day week, one Easter week, the Ascension Friday and the Whitsun week added together, with no overlap between them. Taking both Easter weeks instead of one costs eight leave days for sixteen days off, a worse rate for the same fortnight. The planner on this page draws the whole year so you can test your own allowance.

items.q: Why does the Berlin school calendar matter for my leave request?
items.a: **Because the law gives some colleagues priority.** Section 7 of the Bundesurlaubsgesetz says an employer must take your leave wishes into account unless urgent operational needs or the wishes of other employees who deserve priority on social grounds get in the way, and in practice that usually means colleagues with school-age children. In 2027 the Berlin school year is off 1 to 6 February, 22 March to 2 April, Friday 7 May, 18 and 19 May, 1 July to 14 August, 11 to 23 October and from 22 December, which covers five of the six good windows.

items.q: When is the quietest good week to take off in Berlin in 2027?
items.a: **Tuesday 9 to Friday 12 March.** International Women's Day falls on Monday 8 March 2027, so the weekend before is already long, and four leave days stretch it to nine days off from 6 to 14 March. No Berlin school holiday falls in that week, which makes it the least contested strong window in the year.

items.q: How long is the gap with no public holidays in 2027?
items.a: **228 days.** Whit Monday on 17 May 2027 is the last public holiday of the year that lands on a working day. From 18 May to 31 December there is no free weekday at all, because 3 October is a Sunday and both Christmas holidays fall on the weekend. If you want a long weekend in that stretch you have to buy it outright.

items.q: Do unused German leave days expire at the end of the year?
items.a: **Normally leave has to be taken inside the calendar year,** and section 7 of the Bundesurlaubsgesetz allows a carry-over only for urgent operational or personal reasons, and then only until 31 March. The Federal Labour Court ruled in February 2019 that days do not simply expire unless the employer told the employee how many were left and asked them to take the leave, so an unnoticed balance is not automatically lost. The statutory floor is 24 working days on a six-day week, which is 20 days on a normal five-day week.

items.q: Why does Christmas 2027 cost so much leave?
items.a: **Because both Christmas holidays fall on the weekend.** 25 December 2027 is a Saturday and 26 December is a Sunday, so neither one covers a working day. To be off between Christmas and New Year you have to take Monday 27 to Friday 31 December, five full leave days, for a stretch running 25 December to 2 January. On a 30-day allowance that is a sixth of the year in one block, so it needs to be reserved early.
